name: Cash Deposit Confirmation 1
definition: Confirmation of how the cash receiver will settle the cash deposit.

ValidCashDepositReceived.name: Valid Cash Deposit Received
ValidCashDepositReceived.definition: Confirms the cash received by the cash receiver for a cash deposit request that will be credited to the account.

InvalidCashDepositReceived.name: Invalid Cash Deposit Received
InvalidCashDepositReceived.definition: Confirms the cash received by the cash receiver for a CashDepositRequest that will not be credited to an account, for example the cash is counterfeit.
